ZLaInMc-tIE.title: We're Not Cowboys, We're BUFFALO BOYS 😂 Nepali Village Life & Country Music | Krissy Talks
ZLaInMc-tIE.description:
We're not Nepali cowboys... we're BUFFALO BOYS 🐃🤠 Episode 1 of Krissy Talks, the Nepali podcast where two brothers talk, laugh, joke and spit facts about music, Nepali village life and growing up.

Krissy and his brother Roshan get into how music shapes who you are: why one brother lives on country music (Luke Combs, small-town songs) while the other grew up on Justin Bieber and One Direction. Along the way: what a Nepali cowboy really is (a vaisi gothalo, the buffalo boy), herding goats in the village, bribing your little brother with noodles, saving pocket money for a cheap MP3 player with no Wi-Fi, exam-year nostalgia and older-sibling problems.

Stay to the end: we perform our own original song, "Party in a Parking Lot" 🎶

🎵 Songwriter, lyricist or composer? We're always down to collab. Drop a comment.
💬 Team country music 🤠 or team Justin Bieber? And what should we talk about in Episode 2? 👇
🔔 Subscribe for more Nepali podcast episodes, village life stories and music talk.
